wins: Agent maintained a positive reward trajectory (60.0) despite not achieving mission success, indicating controlled exploration with useful feedback retention
fails: Zero percent mission success rate points to failure to reach critical objective conditions despite 10 mentor interventions

key_outcomes.summary: Reward curve shows controlled progress but persistent inability to translate reconnaissance into objective completion; urgent focus on decisive exploitation sequences is required.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Critical objective conditions remained unmet after reconnaissance, indicating failure to chain into exploitation or completion logic
